4 اقلتهُ He, or it, destroyed him; (K, TA;) said of God, and of a long journey: (TA:) or he (i. e. a man, O) exposed him to destruction; (O, K, TA;) and made him to be on the brink thereof. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And اقلتت She was, or became, such as is termed مِقْلَاتٌ [q. v.]. (S, O, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
